critique: The orange ember and charcoal-smoke palette is appropriate, and the t1-to-t4 expansion clearly shows active motion. However, the effect remains an explosion-like radial burst: a small brown-orange circular ring sits in the center while sparks disperse evenly in all directions and the smoke becomes a diffuse, roughly symmetric cloud. It still lacks a dense, luminous yellow/orange flame body and the vertically rising, irregular smoky structure associated with the Smokey Fire thumbnail.

suggestions.why: Lower initial particle velocity so emitted fire and smoke accumulate into a coherent flame mass instead of immediately forming a large radial spark burst.
Narrow directional spread to break the uniform circular explosion silhouette and concentrate the fire into a more flame-led source.
Raise emission density to fill the dark hollow center with overlapping sprite detail, producing a fuller luminous fire body.
Increase upward acceleration so the retained smoke and fire develop a visible rising plume rather than expanding as a symmetric halo.
